lines.en: Ingrid, the train is late again. If there were no trains, what would you do?
lines.pt: Ingrid, o trem atrasou de novo. Se não houvesse trens, o que você faria?

lines.en: I would drive to work, but the roads would be full of cars.
lines.pt: Eu iria de carro ao trabalho, mas as ruas estariam cheias de carros.

lines.en: True. If everyone drove, the traffic jams would be terrible.
lines.pt: Verdade. Se todo mundo dirigisse, os congestionamentos seriam terríveis.

lines.en: And the air would be bad. I wouldn’t like that.
lines.pt: E o ar seria ruim. Eu não gostaria disso.

lines.en: If I had a lot of money, I would buy a house near my office.
lines.pt: Se eu tivesse muito dinheiro, compraria uma casa perto do escritório.

lines.en: If I lived near my office, I would walk every morning.
lines.pt: Se eu morasse perto do escritório, andaria todas as manhãs.

lines.en: Would you take a bus if the trains stopped for a week?
lines.pt: Você pegaria um ônibus se os trens parassem por uma semana?

lines.en: Yes, I would, but I would leave home at seven.
lines.pt: Pegaria, mas sairia de casa às sete.

lines.en: If I were you, I would sit on the bench and read a book.
lines.pt: Se eu fosse você, eu me sentaria no banco e leria um livro.

lines.en: Good idea. If the train came on time, we would be at work by nine.
lines.pt: Boa ideia. Se o trem chegasse na hora, estaríamos no trabalho às nove.

lines.en: Look, it is coming! We will find a seat if we walk fast.
lines.pt: Olhe, ele está chegando! Vamos achar lugar se andarmos rápido.

facts.big: If there were no trains, I would drive
facts.label: Segundo condicional
facts.sub: If + passado simples, would + verbo base: If I had money, I would buy a house. If I were you, I would wait.

facts.label: Se + passado, + condicional
facts.sub: Use if + passado simples para uma situação imaginária: If I had money, I would buy a house. Depois, use would + verbo base. O passado aqui não é real.

facts.label: Se eu fosse você
facts.sub: Para conselho, use If I were you, I would…: If I were you, I would wait. Com were para todos os sujeitos: If he were rich.

compare.ask: If I had money, I would buy a house.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “Se eu tivesse dinheiro, eu compraria uma casa”.
compare.tip: Diga: “If I had money, I would buy a house.”
compare.us: Em inglês, use if + passado simples e would + verbo: If I had money, I would buy a house. Para to be, use were com todos: If I were you, I would wait. Nunca use would depois de if.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: If I had money, I would buy a house.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: After if we use the past simple.
We say “If there would be no trains”.
items.why: We say If there were no trains.

items.s: With I, we can say “If I were you”.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: After if we use the past simple. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “If there would be no trains”. → Falso (We say If there were no trains.)
With I, we can say “If I were you”. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A station in Dallas · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a busy morning in Dallas. Ela and Sara wait at the station. Many commuters stand on the platform. A voice says there is a delay. The train is not on schedule. Ela starts to imagine a different day.

“Sara, the train is late again. If there were no trains, what would you do?” says Ela. “I would drive to work, but the roads would be full of cars.” says Sara. “True. If everyone drove, the traffic jams would be terrible.” says Ela.
